name: Tanjiro Kamado Sun Breathing Vintage Graphic T-Shirt
description: An oversized cotton tee with a worn-in Hinokami Kagura flame design printed on the back.
details: Screen-printed in Tokyo with wash-resistant reactive dye. Ribbed collar and drop-shoulder fit.

name: Satoru Gojo 'Hollow Purple' Limited Scale Figure
description: A 1/7 scale Gojo figure with clear technique effects and a light-up base, made for displaying on a shelf.
details: The figure stands 28 cm tall and comes with interchangeable blindfolded and unmasked face parts.

name: Elden Ring: Ranni the Witch Resin Statue (Collector Edition)
description: A hand-painted Ranni statue with her flowing cape, spectral details, and the Dark Moon Greatsword.
details: Each statue is individually numbered. The limited run includes a certificate of authenticity.

name: Cyberpunk 2077 Samurai Bomber Jacket (LED Collar Edition)
description: A Samurai-inspired bomber jacket with an illuminated blue collar and an embroidered patch on the back.
details: The collar lights recharge by USB. The jacket has a weathered-look faux leather shell and ribbed cuffs.

name: Dune: Crysknife of Arrakis Prop Replica & Display Stand
description: A full-size resin replica of the Crysknife, designed with a surface inspired by the tooth of a sandworm.
details: The replica is 48 cm long and has etched Fremen-inspired markings. A brass-look magnetic wall mount is included.

name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse Miles Morales Jordan 1 Sneaker Art Print
description: A 24-by-36-inch art print of Miles Morales, made on archival cotton paper with a comic-style halftone finish.
details: The print includes an embossed artist seal and ships in a reinforced mailing tube. Keep it out of direct sunlight to help preserve the colors.

name: Arcane: Jinx 'Fishbones' Mini Plush Rocket
description: A soft plush version of Jinx's shark-faced Fishbones rocket, finished with shiny accent details.
details: The plush measures 35 cm and has embroidered teeth and bright painted details.

name: Stranger Things: Hellfire Club Raglan 3/4 Sleeve Shirt
description: A Hellfire Club baseball-style shirt inspired by the one Eddie wears in Stranger Things.
details: Made from combed ring-spun cotton, with a pre-shrunk vintage wash and contrasting black sleeves.

name: BTS Official Lightstick Special Edition: ARMY Bomb Ver. 4
description: A Bluetooth-enabled ARMY Bomb lightstick with five lighting modes, a holographic emblem, and member photo cards.
details: The set includes seven photo cards, a velvet storage bag, and a wrist strap. It can connect to compatible concert light controls.

name: BLACKPINK 'Born Pink' World Tour Cropped Hoodie
description: A cropped, fleece-lined hoodie with Born Pink lettering on the front and tour stops printed along the sleeves.
details: Made from heavyweight French terry with a cotton-polyester blend and logo-engraved metal drawstring tips.

name: The Dark Knight Bat-Signal Desktop LED Lamp
description: A rotating desktop spotlight that projects the Bat-Signal onto a nearby wall or ceiling.
details: Runs on USB-C or three AAA batteries and comes with a tilting stand featuring a Gotham skyline.

name: Berserk: Dragon Slayer Sword 1:1 Scale Wall Trophy Plaque
description: A large display replica of Guts' Dragon Slayer sword, made from reinforced polyurethane rather than metal.
details: The replica weighs 6.2 kg and has a hand-weathered finish. Chain hardware is included for display.

name: Solo Leveling: Shadow Monarch Sung Jin-woo Enamel Pin Set
description: A set of hard enamel pins featuring Jin-woo, Igris, and Beru, with glow-in-the-dark shadow details.
details: The pins have black nickel plating and double rubber backs, and come on a display card.

name: NewJeans Binky Bong Official Lightstick (Tokki Bunny)
description: A bunny-eared lightstick with soft gradient lighting and interchangeable Tokki face pieces.
details: Pairs with the official Bunnies app over Bluetooth and includes a lanyard and sticker pack.
